product.name: Phase Flag
product.description: Production-grade feature flagging SaaS — OSS, SaaS, and Enterprise deployment modes

stories.title: Verify migration completeness and tool availability
stories.description: Confirm the full source tree has been copied to the phase-flag master folder, that all required CLI tools are present and authenticated, and that the project structure matches expectations.
acceptance_criteria: Working directory exists with core/, sdks/, enterprise/, portal/, marketing/, infra/, docs/, tools/, tests/, scripts/, scaffold/
core/api/ has pyproject.toml with fastapi dependency
core/dashboard/ has package.json with react@18
core/cli/ has go.mod
core/relay/ has go.mod
All tools available: gh, docker, poetry, npm, go, git, jq
gh auth status shows active session
docker info returns valid output
CLAUDE.md, prd.json, progress.txt all present at project root
progress.txt created (may be empty)

stories.title: Verify and finalize GitHub Actions CI path references
stories.description: Confirm all GitHub Actions workflow files in .github/workflows/ reference correct paths for the monorepo root (e.g. 'core/api/**' not 'phaseflag/core/api/**'). Fix any remaining incorrect paths.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/api-ci.yml paths trigger on 'core/api/**'
.github/workflows/dashboard-ci.yml paths trigger on 'core/dashboard/**'
.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml paths trigger on 'core/api/**', 'core/relay/**', 'core/dashboard/**'
.github/workflows/release.yml build contexts reference 'core/api', 'core/relay', 'core/cli'
.github/workflows/sdk-ci.yml paths trigger on 'sdks/**'
All cd commands in workflows reference correct relative paths (core/api, sdks/javascript, etc.)
No remaining 'phaseflag/core/' or 'phaseflag/sdks/' path references in workflow files

stories.title: Verify local development stack starts end-to-end
stories.description: Start the full local dev stack using infra/docker/docker-compose.yml, run Alembic migrations, verify the API health endpoint, and confirm the dashboard builds cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: infra/docker/docker-compose.yml build contexts reference correct relative paths (../../core/api, ../../core/dashboard)
docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d succeeds
docker compose ps shows api, dashboard, db containers running
curl http://localhost:8000/health returns 200
curl http://localhost:8000/docs returns 200 (Swagger UI)
poetry run alembic upgrade head succeeds in core/api/
npm run build succeeds in core/dashboard/
docker compose down cleans up all containers

stories.title: Create root .gitignore
stories.description: Create a comprehensive root .gitignore that covers all languages and tools used in this monorepo: Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, Java, and general artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: .gitignore present at project root
Python artifacts excluded: __pycache__/, *.pyc, *.pyo, *.pyd, .venv/, .env, dist/, *.egg-info/
SQLite dev files excluded: *.db, *.db-shm, *.db-wal
Node.js artifacts excluded: node_modules/, dist/, .next/, .turbo/
Go artifacts excluded: bin/, *.test
Rust artifacts excluded: target/
General artifacts excluded: .DS_Store, *.log, .idea/, .vscode/
Secrets excluded: .env, .env.local, .env.*.local, *.pem, *.key
Docker excluded: .dockerignore entries not needed in root gitignore

stories.title: Initialize git repository and make initial commit
stories.description: Initialize git in the phase-flag root, add the .gitignore, stage all source files, and make the initial commit. Do NOT push to GitHub yet (that is US-006).
acceptance_criteria: git init at project root succeeds
.gitignore committed
git add . stages all source files (excluding gitignored artifacts)
git commit -m 'Initial commit: Phase Flag platform monorepo' succeeds
git log shows 1 commit
git status shows clean working tree

stories.title: Create GitHub repository and push monorepo
stories.description: Create the phaseflag GitHub repository under the phaseflag org (or user account), set the remote, and push the monorepo.

git remote add origin https://github.com/phaseflag/phaseflag.git
git push -u origin main succeeds
gh repo view phaseflag/phaseflag confirms repository with commits
Repository description set: 'Production-grade feature flagging SaaS'

gh workflow list shows all 5 workflows

stories.title: Validate API CI workflow on feature branch

stories.title: Security hardening audit
stories.description: Audit and verify the API security posture: rate limiting, security headers, input validation, and JWT handling.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiting active: rapid requests (>120/min) return 429 Too Many Requests
Security headers present on all responses: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Strict-Transport-Security (on HTTPS), Content-Security-Policy
All POST/PUT endpoints validated with Pydantic — no raw dict access
SQL injection test: flag key with SQL metacharacters returns 422, not 500
JWT expiry enforced: expired token returns 401 Unauthorized
API keys not exposed in logs (grep for api_key in log output)
Safety headers verified: curl -I https://api.phaseflag.io/health shows all required headers
Security findings documented in docs/security.md
